description: Acknowledge paid Coupang orders — moves them from ACCEPT (결제완료) to INSTRUCT (상품준비중). Up to 50 shipmentBoxIds per call; partial failures are reported per id. 발주서를 상품준비중으로 처리합니다. Use after reviewing new orders with coupang_list_orders. Needs shipmentBoxIds. Irreversible from the API.

confirm_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: the tool then only returns a preview and a token. Show the preview to the user, and only after they agree call again with exactly the same arguments plus this token. 처음엔 비워 두세요. 미리보기를 사용자에게 보여주고 동의를 받은 뒤, 같은 인자에 이 토큰을 넣어 다시 호출합니다.

name: coupang_confirm_orders
